questions.question:
Create a Pod named `entry-override` in the `fortress` namespace using the `nginx:alpine` image.
The image normally starts nginx. You must override both the entrypoint and the command so the Pod runs `sleep` for `3600` seconds.

- Command (entrypoint override): `["sleep"]`
- Args (CMD override): `["3600"]`

Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/1/pod.yaml`.

Create a ConfigMap named `init-script-cm` in the `fortress` namespace with a single key `setup.sh` containing:

```
#!/bin/sh
echo "Initialization successful!" > /work-dir/index.html
```

Then create a Pod named `web-setup` using the `nginx:alpine` image. Add an init container named `init-setup` using the `busybox:1.36` image. The init container must:

1. Mount the ConfigMap `init-script-cm` at `/scripts`
2. Mount an emptyDir volume named `work-vol` at `/work-dir`
3. Execute `sh /scripts/setup.sh`

The main `web-setup` container must mount the same `work-vol` at `/usr/share/nginx/html`.
Save the Pod manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/2/init-pod.yaml`.

Create a CronJob named `siege-report` in the `siege` namespace.

- It runs a container using the `busybox:1.36` image.
- Command: `/bin/sh, -c, date; echo Hello from siege`.
- It runs every hour on the half hour (e.g. 00:30, 01:30) -> schedule `30 * * * *`.
- It must be scheduled in the `Asia/Tokyo` timezone (requires Kubernetes 1.27+).

Save the CronJob manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/3/cronjob.yaml`.

Create a multi-container Pod named `process-monitor` in the `bastion` namespace. The Pod must share the PID namespace between all containers.

- Container 1: `nginx-app` using `nginx:alpine`.
- Container 2: `monitor-app` using `busybox:1.36`.

The `monitor-app` container runs a continuous loop listing processes every 5 seconds:
`["/bin/sh", "-c", "while true; do ps -ef; sleep 5; done"]`

Ensure `shareProcessNamespace: true` is set at the Pod level.
Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/4/shared-pid.yaml`.

A Helm release named `battle-web` exists in the `garrison` namespace.
Upgrade it using the chart located at `/tmp/exam/course/5/battle-chart/`.

The upgrade must be ATOMIC (roll back automatically on failure) and have a timeout of `1m`.
Set the chart value `replicaCount` to `3` during the upgrade.

Note: your task is purely to execute the Helm upgrade command with the correct flags.

Create a Deployment named `citadel-guard` in the `citadel` namespace.

- Replicas: `4`
- Image: `nginx:1.24.0-alpine`
- Labels: `app=guard`

Configure the deployment so that if it takes more than `15` seconds to roll out it is considered failed (`progressDeadlineSeconds`).
Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/6/deploy.yaml` and apply it.

In the `rampart` namespace there is a deployment named `api-server-blue` and a service named `api-svc`. Currently `api-svc` routes traffic to the `api-server-blue` pods.

1. Create a new deployment named `api-server-green` with image `nginx:1.25.0-alpine` and labels `app: api-server-green`. Set replicas to 2.
2. Update the `api-svc` Service to route traffic to the `api-server-green` pods instead of blue.
3. Do NOT delete the `api-server-blue` deployment.

A base kustomization structure exists at `/tmp/exam/course/8/`.
Modify the `kustomization.yaml` file in this directory to apply two transformations to the base resources:

1. Override the `nginx` image to `nginx:1.23.0-alpine`.
2. Apply a patch to scale the `vanguard-web` deployment to `5` replicas.

Apply the customized manifests to the `vanguard` namespace.
Save your built manifests to `/tmp/exam/course/8/kustomize-output.yaml`.

A Pod named `data-processor` in the `sentinel` namespace is crashing (it is being OOMKilled).
Modify the Pod (you may need to delete and recreate it) to increase its memory limit to `256Mi`. Keep the requests at `64Mi`.
Ensure the Pod reaches the `Running` state.

The Pod `secure-app` in the `outpost` namespace contains a distroless container that lacks a shell. You need to inspect its filesystem.
Add an ephemeral container to `secure-app` using the `busybox:1.36` image, named `debugger`.
Ensure the ephemeral container stays running so the scoring script can detect it (e.g. `--command -- sh -c "sleep 3600"`).

A Deployment named `weapon-smith` in the `armory` namespace is failing to scale up its pods due to a `ResourceQuota` named `armory-quota`.
Troubleshoot and adjust the `weapon-smith` deployment so its pods fit within the quota.

Requirements for `weapon-smith` pods:

- They must request exactly `100m` CPU and `128Mi` memory.
- You cannot modify or delete the `armory-quota` ResourceQuota.

Scale the deployment to `3` replicas if it is not already.

verification.description: Pod requests are `100m` CPU and `128Mi` memory

questions.question:
Create a Pod named `resource-aware` in the `fortress` namespace using the `busybox:1.36` image, running `sleep 3600`.
Configure the container with:

- CPU Request: `200m`
- Memory Limit: `256Mi`

Expose the CPU request and Memory limit as environment variables via the Downward API:

- `MY_CPU_REQUEST` reflects the CPU requests.
- `MY_MEM_LIMIT` reflects the Memory limits.

Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/12/downward.yaml`.

1. Create a ServiceAccount named `stealth-sa` in the `siege` namespace.
2. Create a Pod named `stealth-pod` in the same namespace using the `nginx:alpine` image and the `stealth-sa` ServiceAccount.
3. The pod MUST NOT automount the ServiceAccount token (`automountServiceAccountToken: false`).
4. Instead, manually mount the ServiceAccount token (projected volume) to `/var/run/secrets/custom-token`.

Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/13/sa-pod.yaml`.

Create a Pod named `secure-workload` in the `bastion` namespace using the `nginx:alpine` image.
Configure the Pod's SecurityContext to use the `RuntimeDefault` seccomp profile.
Ensure the container runs as a non-root user (e.g. `runAsUser: 1000` and `runAsNonRoot: true`).
Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/14/seccomp.yaml`.

1. Create a Secret named `db-credentials` in the `citadel` namespace with two keys: `username` (value `admin`) and `password` (value `hachiman_rocks`).
2. Create a Pod named `db-consumer` using the `alpine:3.18` image running `sleep 3600`.
3. Mount the `db-credentials` secret as a volume at `/etc/db-creds/`.
4. ONLY the `password` key should be mounted as a file named `db-pass.txt` inside `/etc/db-creds/`. The `username` key must NOT be present as a file.

Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/15/multi-secret.yaml`.

Create a LimitRange named `rampart-limits` in the `rampart` namespace enforcing these defaults for all new Pods:

- Default Limit: `Memory 512Mi`, `CPU 500m`
- Default Request: `Memory 256Mi`, `CPU 200m`

After creating the LimitRange, create a Pod named `default-pod` using the `nginx:alpine` image with NO explicit resource requests/limits, letting it inherit the defaults.
Save the LimitRange and Pod manifests to `/tmp/exam/course/16/limit-range.yaml`.

Create a NetworkPolicy named `protect-db` in the `vanguard` namespace.
It applies to pods with the label `role=db`.
Allow INGRESS traffic on TCP port `5432` from:

1. Pods in the `vanguard` namespace with the label `role=backend`
2. ANY pod in the `bastion` namespace (which has label `kubernetes.io/metadata.name=bastion`).

Deny all other ingress traffic to pods with `role=db`.
Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/17/netpol.yaml`.

An Ingress named `main-ingress` exists in the `sentinel` namespace, routing `sentinel.dojo.com` to `main-svc`.
Create a new Ingress named `canary-ingress` in the `sentinel` namespace.
Configure it as a canary release routing 20% of traffic to a service named `canary-svc` (you don't need to create it) on port 80, triggering on the same host `sentinel.dojo.com`.
Add the necessary NGINX ingress canary annotations.
Save the manifest to `/tmp/exam/course/18/ingress.yaml`.

Create a Service named `external-db` in the `outpost` namespace.
It must NOT use a label selector. Configure it to expose TCP port `3306`.
Manually create an Endpoints object named `external-db` that maps to IP address `10.50.50.50` on port `3306`.
Save the manifests to `/tmp/exam/course/19/manual-svc.yaml`.

Investigate the `coredns` ConfigMap in the `kube-system` namespace. You need to add a custom DNS rewrite rule.
Modify the `coredns` ConfigMap so any DNS query for `hachiman.local` is rewritten to `hachiman.garrison.svc.cluster.local`.
(Hint: use the `rewrite name exact hachiman.local hachiman.garrison.svc.cluster.local` plugin inside the Corefile block.)
Save a copy of the modified ConfigMap to `/tmp/exam/course/20/coredns.yaml`.
You DO NOT need to restart the CoreDNS pods.
